derivation:
by
  simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_two, h i] using
    (Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun k => ‖M i k‖ ^ 2) (by intros; positivity) (Finset.mem_univ j))
explanation: Each nonnegative summand is bounded by the sum. Apply this to the squared norms in row i; RowUnit identifies their sum with 1.
